The fetched UN M49 excerpt lists country and area code entries. The report does not state a reference area, so UN M49 is not used in the field set or source mappings.

This codebook preserves two statistical structures from the accepted DSD / Key Family artefact: KF_EDU_ENROLLMENT and KF_EDU_LOWER_SECONDARY_COMPLETION. It does not add INDICATOR as a DSD dimension because the accepted DSDs have fixed statistical scopes.

SDMX_KEY_FAMILY is a non-observation routing/control field used by templates to select one of the accepted DSD / Key Family structures. It is not an SDMX observation component, not a formal data attribute, and not governed by a codelist in this mapping. Its allowed values are accepted DSD identifiers governed by the DSD / Key Family artefact, not codelist codes.

Report-level reference metadata concepts from page 1 are not included in fields because this schema only permits DIMENSION, TIME, MEASURE, and ATTRIBUTE roles, and labeling those concepts as ATTRIBUTE would be misleading. They are retained in source_value_mappings as mappings to MSD/reference metadata concepts rather than DSD observation components.

Codelist identifiers are made operationally consistent with the accepted codelist artefact. Where the accepted DSD used draft IDs, these aliases are treated as the same governed local holding lists for this template: CL_EDUCATION_LEVEL_LOCAL = CL_EDUCATION_LEVEL_REPORT_LOCAL; CL_WEALTH_QUINTILE_SURVEY_LOCAL = CL_WEALTH_QUINTILE_REPORT_LOCAL; CL_EDU_UNIT_MEASURE_LOCAL = CL_UNIT_MEASURE_EDU_REPORT_LOCAL; CL_EDU_OBS_STATUS_LOCAL = CL_OBS_STATUS_EDU_REPORT_LOCAL.

Local holding-code mappings to governed local codelists are approved for automatic local staging only when the printed source value exactly matches the mapped label. This approval does not authorise replacement with external standard codes such as ISCED, SDMX CL_SEX, SDMX CL_FREQ, authoritative unit lists, or SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS.

FREQ is present because the accepted DSDs include it, but the report only prints a Year column. Operational rule: do not auto-generate complete SDMX observation rows until a human confirms the mandatory frequency value and the authoritative CL_FREQ code/version; leave FREQ blank or flagged unresolved in staging templates.
The report does not state a reference area or country; REF_AREA is not included and no geographic source mapping is made.
Education-level values are retained as local report codes pending ISCED review because the report explicitly requires ISCED mapping review and no confirmed ISCED version or code mapping was supplied.
Sex values are mapped to local holding codes only; the supplied external evidence does not confirm exact SDMX CL_SEX code identifiers, version, or the scope of Total.

Wealth quintiles are survey-specific and are not mapped to a standard income or wealth classification. The completion table includes only Lowest, Middle, and Highest quintile; second and fourth quintiles are not invented.
Unit values Students and Percent are mapped to local unit codes because no authoritative unit-measure codelist or code mapping was confirmed from supplied evidence.
Observation status values are mapped to local holding codes; exact mappings to SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS or to a separate modelling-method attribute were not confirmed.

EDUCATION_LEVEL is mandatory for enrollment observations and not applicable for lower-secondary completion observations; WEALTH_QUINTILE is mandatory for lower-secondary completion observations and not applicable for enrollment observations.
The report is synthetic and does not provide detailed construction rules for wealth quintiles, sex Total, model estimates, or duplicate-removal procedures.
